blockers.detail: PartitionService accepts an injected raftProvider and otherwise createRaftProvider(options); RAFT_BACKEND_DEFAULT remains liferaft while raft-rs-wasm is explicit-selection only.

No durable release-full-v1 proof ref exists for 8ed8f889cfa817c6d786ca688f581c83bc1573a5 at re-measure time; the partition backend default is still liferaft, so an exact-main release proof of the rs-raft path is not yet meaningful.

consensusMembership.detail: On the rs-raft path the core's committed ConfState is current consensus membership. Stable peer identity reservation and service/cache metadata are separate host concerns; metadata may request/project a transition but is not itself the committed configuration.

transport.outbound: raft-rs runtime owner emits one semantic envelope {protocol: raft-rs, groupId, from, to, message} -> sendToPeer -> PartitionService request callback -> MessageRouter.deliver (direct-consensus path classified by the shared consensus-transport classifier)
transport.inbound: MessageRouter handler -> PartitionService.handleTransportMessage -> raft-packet-utils classifies native legacy packet vs semantic rs-raft envelope -> the semantic envelope reaches the frozen operation port step() unchanged; no sender-membership filtering, no placement policy, no fake legacy packet
transport.notCertified: restart/catch-up over the real transport, learner promotion and removal under real transport, and cold formation on rs-raft remain the hard-cutover epic's certification items (steps 4-5 of the 2026-09-23 handover)

documentation.detail: Current-state docs now describe the provider/operation-port boundary, Liferaft production default, rs-raft/WASM integrated-but-not-cut-over status, and ConfState-versus-policy ownership distinction.

fixtureReachThrough.detail: Seven test files reached through the frozen port after #46 (red on main, hidden by cone selection). PR #52 migrated the DT6 learner-promotion fixture and witnesses, the snapshot catch-up end-to-end witness, the packet round-trip property and three partition-service suites. Still red on main, outside that cone: test/bootstrap/production-scheduling-defaults.test.js, test/convergence/dt6-ledger-leader-durability-fitness.test.js, test/query/write-path-internal-pacing.test.js.

pushGateStatics.detail: main carried three static reds since #46 that refused every hook-gated push (file-size ratchet 28/27, complexity ratchet 1817/1816, four literal violations in liferaft-provider.js); all three are repaired on this head.

adversarialChecks.detail: Omitting raftBackend selects the named liferaft default.
PartitionService still accepts options.raftProvider; this is a construction seam and must be censused at cutover.
Existing operation-boundary audit and witness cover raw binding/core/facade/lifecycle-writer bypasses.
Peer identity reservation is not ConfState membership authority.
Hostile-cache real-partition proof keeps committed ConfState authoritative.
Inbound partition demux hands a semantic rs-raft envelope to the frozen operation port step(); legacy packets keep their native path; the transport validates envelope/routing facts only.
Message-group Liferaft is separately owned and is not evidence of partition fallback.
No exact-SHA durable release-full-v1 receipt was present for the measured main commit.
